g.text: swap_router and fee_bps fixed at creation
a mock Jupiter, fixed at strategy creation

svg.text: the share count falls before any token
The program sells nothing to pay her:
she is handed her proportional slice of
every vault, each amount floored, each
destination account verified to be hers
her USDC slice is zero — every deposit
deployed fully, so nothing idle waits to
be paid out — and her min_usdc_out floor
she entered with $900, rode NVIDIA up, paid
Maria 1% by dilution and left with about $950
of assets. Bob still holds 450 shares.
